todos: [P2] LIVE-MODEL-HARDWARE-01: The live harness accepts ONLYRAG_LIVE_MODEL without changing saved settings. On 2026-09-28 qwen3.5:4b was 100% GPU at 8K/16K (about 5.4-5.7 GiB VRAM, 72-75 generated tok/s in initial runs); two runs stopped on context overflow before the fix. After the fix, an isolated 16K run reached 50/50 turns without overflow, completed 51 tool calls and 3/9 milestones, then stopped at step_budget with a failed build. A same-prompt 16K qwen3.5:2b run was 100% GPU (2.6 GB Ollama model memory, 4.6 GiB total VRAM used), about 103 generated and 18,943 prompt tok/s over 45 generations, 50 tool calls (12 failed/blocked), 1/9 milestones, failed build and blocked/step_budget at 50/50 in 186 seconds. Neither model meets the qualification threshold, so no usable default is selected. The 9b model is 6.6 GB before context and likely to exceed 8 GiB VRAM. A 2026-09-28 pull was interrupted after about 154 MB when throughput fell to 3.8-4.7 MB/s (over 20 minutes remaining); it is not installed or measured. Ollama retained 17 resumable partial blob files for this digest in its model store; do not treat them as app userData. Next session, resume the pull only if bandwidth permits or remove that partial download through Ollama maintenance, then measure residency before any full run. Audit snapshots remain under %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live. Snapshot inspection on 2026-09-28 found that 2B left src/main.tsx importing absent src/App and src/index.css; 4B left src/App.tsx importing absent src/components/Sidebar and src/pages/TasksPage while src/pages/Tasks.tsx exists. The 4B run failed npm run build at step 42, made six successful file edits at steps 43-48, then failed build again at step 50 with TS2307 and TS2614. The focused qwen3.5:4b TS2613 probe reached 12/12 with a final buildable source. Its application-owned verification passed, but the milestone remained open because the human-readable command label .: npm run build was compared with npm run build; this mapping is now fixed and has a regression test. The run still ends blocked at step_budget by design, and the model spent steps editing tsconfig unnecessarily. The isolated 2026-09-28 qwen3.5:4b TS2613 rerun passed its live test: the final build succeeded and 1/1 milestone was verified at step 12/12, confirming the command-label fix. The run remained unverifiable at step_budget and the model again edited tsconfig unnecessarily. A post-fix 16K full-task rerun on 2026-09-28 verified 3/9 milestones in 20/50 steps and stopped blocked/circuit_breaker on no_mutation; after step 8 the model only inspected files and made two failed shell calls, without running the final build. The live test exited 1. Do not select this model as default without a successful full-task qualification. Model source: https://ollama.com/library/qwen3.5 .
